notes.title: Update Notes for December 2nd 2023
notes.content:
-	Fixed waiter not resuming cleaning tables after sink or dishwasher was emptied.
-	Changed "No place to put dirty dishes" from blocking to non blocking PopUp.
-	Fixed crash d3d11 buffer error from driver.
-	Fixed price not displaying in shop for some languages.
-	Fixed wrong outfit in character customization.
-	Fixed floating navmesh in lake map Ample Shoreline.
-	Fixed run tracks in lake map Archipelago Beach and Ample Shoreline.
-	Changed maximum amount of tables allowed in the restaurant for luxury from 5 to 8.
